transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Good day, Signore Salieri. You find me in the stead of the master builder today, as he is presently visiting suppliers and will not return for several weeks. How may I assist you with your inquiry?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Ah, Signore, I am here on behalf of the Emperor himself. We have recently procured a custom-built fortepiano from your workshop, but upon its delivery, we have discovered several defects. The keys stick, the pedal mechanism is faulty, and the tone in the upper register is quite thin and tinny. We require immediate rectification of these issues. May I expect the repairs to be completed within a reasonable timeframe?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I understand your concerns, Signore Salieri, and it is always our aim to ensure our instruments are of the highest quality. However, I must inform you that all commissions from this workshop are considered fulfilled upon delivery and acceptance. The Court’s own servants did sign the receipt, confirming that they were content with the instrument as delivered. Our guild rules forbid reopening a completed commission without the master’s personal approval, which means I am unable to either repair or replace the fortepiano at this time. I regret any inconvenience this causes.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: This is most unfortunate, Signore. We had hoped for a flawless instrument. However, we shall accept your word for now. If we decide to have the piano repaired in the future, I shall definitely come to this workshop. Thank you for your understanding.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
